name: Generic OpenID Connect application
description: A confidential web application that signs in with the authorization code flow and PKCE. Use it for products without a template.

placeholders.label: Application callback URL
placeholders.hint: The redirect (callback) URL the application shows when you add an OpenID Connect provider.

claims.name: sub
claims.description: A stable account identifier (the Claviger record id).

claims.name: collection
claims.description: The name of the auth collection the account belongs to.

claims.name: email_verified
claims.description: Whether the email address is verified.

claims.name: name
claims.description: The member's display name, when the collection has a name field.

claims.name: preferred_username
claims.description: The username, when the collection has a username field.

claims.name: updated_at
claims.description: When the account was last changed.
